Narrated by Michael B. Jordan, travel to the lush American Southeast in this full episode of America the Beautiful. Experience the extraordinary lives of animal heroes that slip between land and water to survive in one of the continent's most dynamic ecosystems. When a violent hurricane strikes, see how nature itself constructs the ultimate storm defense, allowing native wildlife to endure the chaos and protect their wild habitats. Featuring black bears, alligators, manatees, raccoons, and more!
